description: This file defines a JPA entity class 'DiscussionThread' representing discussion threads in a learning management system backend. It maps to the 'discussion_threads' database table and includes fields for id, courseId, title, createdBy, and createdAt, along with corresponding constructors and getter methods.

classes.name: DiscussionThread
classes.description: Entity class representing a discussion thread, with fields for thread details and persistence annotations.

methods.name: DiscussionThread()
methods.description: Default protected constructor used by JPA.

methods.name: DiscussionThread(Long courseId, String title, Long createdBy)
methods.description: Constructor to create a new discussion thread with specified course ID, title, and creator ID.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the discussion thread.

methods.name: getCourseId()
methods.description: Returns the course ID associated with the discussion thread.

methods.name: getTitle()
methods.description: Returns the title of the discussion thread.

methods.name: getCreatedBy()
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who created the thread.

methods.name: getCreatedAt()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the thread was created.
